comment: A skull on the pedal screen that reacts to the signal (MS-70CDR 2.10, zvis): a shaded three-quarter skull (own 3D model, dithered): the jaw opens with level, the eyes light up, a shake on attacks, and at the very loudest it explodes and re-forms. Pass-through. Firmware facts: Leemuzhko's ZOOM_development SDK (credited, own code).

params.name: Sense
params.comment: How much signal it takes to open the jaw.

params.name: Decay
params.comment: How fast the face relaxes after a note.

params.name: Shake
params.comment: How hard the skull jolts on attacks (0 = never).

params.name: Boom
params.comment: At the very loudest the skull explodes and re-forms. 0 = never; higher = easier to set off.
